segments.an10.214:1.1: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye.
segments.an10.214:1.5: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye.
segments.an10.214:2.1: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ sagge.
segments.an10.214:2.3: Pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā hoti … pe … sammādiṭṭhikā hoti ….
segments.an10.214:2.5: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgatā upāsikā yathābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ sagge”.
